ticket.title: Choose the benchmark goals, quality gates, and experiment limits

provenance: Exact answers and note supplied in the orchestrator follow-up in this thread. No direct interview or inferred human answers added.

answers.Q2_note: use titles that i'm well aware of, from the 1990-2010 era that i scored highly and few low ones. reviews should always include a frontier model judging the quality and summarize that + recommendations for my picks

application.priorities: Quality first; complete title analysis and discovery usefulness before cost/speed tradeoffs.
application.corpus_constraint: Initial development review: familiar titles from own recorded ratings; 1990–2010 inclusive; mostly high-rated, a few low-rated contrasts. Exact identities/mix remain with corpus decision.
application.frontier_review: Required each review round before picks, using existing authorized Astra sessions, summarized with evidence, uncertainty and recommendations. No separately billed judge APIs.
application.human_evidence_classification: Assisted after exposure to frontier recommendation; candidate-label blinding is separate from independence.
application.limits: Unchanged sample/request/concurrency/retry/time/token ceilings from the presented draft.

reversible_defaults_not_new_human_answer: Suggest 8 high-rated and 2 low-rated titles if 10 suitable familiar records exist; exact mix and rating definitions belong to corpus decision.
Retain target of 20 paired reference/relevance judgments and 6 full-output spot checks within the 45-minute human cap; do not treat as independent evidence after recommendation exposure.
Astra initial quality pass uses shuffled candidate labels with provider/rank/cost hidden where feasible; preserve exposure and show requested recommendations before human picks.
